name: accretion-ui-chromatic
description: Storybook and Chromatic workspace for Accretion UI wrappers.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix react install && npm --prefix angular_18 install && npm --prefix angular_21 install
scripts.test:accordion: npm run build:react && npm run build:angular_18 && npm run build:angular_21 && playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts
scripts.chromatic:all: npm run chromatic:react && npm run chromatic:angular_18 && npm run chromatic:angular_21
